title: Eurocopter Tiger ARH (pilot)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Tiger ARH (armed reconnaissance helicopter) is the Australian version of the Tiger, with a sight on the roof of the cockpit, a 30 mm gun turret and Hellfire missiles. The pilot's controls and panels are taken as those of the Tiger HAP/HAD, so this guide builds on that guide.
